findings.description: TLS 1.0 is enabled on the target. TLS 1.0 is vulnerable to BEAST (CVE-2011-3389) and POODLE-over-TLS. It has been deprecated by RFC 8996 and is prohibited by PCI DSS since June 2018.
findings.mitigation: Disable TLS 1.0 and TLS 1.1. Accept only TLS 1.2 and TLS 1.3.
findings.title: TLS 1.0 Enabled

findings.description: TLS 1.1 is enabled on the target. TLS 1.1 has been deprecated by RFC 8996. While fewer vulnerabilities exist than TLS 1.0, it is considered insecure by current standards.
findings.mitigation: Disable TLS 1.1. Accept only TLS 1.2 and TLS 1.3.
findings.title: TLS 1.1 Enabled
